shortDescription: Manage ZFS delegated administration (user admin privileges)

options.name: descendents
options.description: Apply permissions to O(name)'s descendents (C(zfs allow -d)).

options.name: groups
options.description: List of groups to whom permission(s) should be granted.

options.name: local
options.description: Apply permissions to O(name) locally (C(zfs allow -l)).

options.name: name
options.description: File system or volume name, for example V(rpool/myfs).

options.name: permissions
options.description: The list of permission(s) to delegate (required if O(state=present)). Supported permissions depend on the ZFS version in use. See for example U(https://openzfs.github.io/openzfs-docs/man/8/zfs-allow.8.html) for OpenZFS.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to allow (V(present)), or unallow (V(absent)) a permission. When set to V(present), at least one "entity" param of O(users), O(groups), or O(everyone) are required. When set to V(absent), removes permissions from the specified entities, or removes all permissions if no entity params are specified.

options.name: users
options.description: List of users to whom permission(s) should be granted.
